lesson: A selector that protects a shared regression floor can choose a much weaker specialist model. Treat that as evidence of representation interference, not proof that specialization is unnecessary.

Direct joint adaptation raised relation capability strongly but degraded the generic structured-state view. Preserve the generic view and add a specialist evidence view rather than forcing one representation to serve conflicting objectives.
Fixed relation relevance priors are unsafe when relation usefulness is query-dependent. Superseded evidence can be wrong for current-state queries and correct for historical queries.
Conflict semantics must remain invariant to canonical storage direction. Learned conflict pooling should use symmetric endpoint features.
Parameter counts are measurements, not capability ceilings. Compare capacity only after capability/fidelity requirements are satisfied.
Reuse frozen semantic caches when architecture experiments occur above the semantic substrate. This preserves GPU time without constraining model capacity.
